```{r}
library(haven)
BRFSS2023 <- read_xpt("LLCP2023.XPT")
```

```{r}
# 将 BRFSS2023 命名为 df
df <- BRFSS2023
nrow(df)
# 过滤出 _STATE 等于 29 的数据
df_state <- df[df$`_STATE` == 29, ]
nrow(df_state)
df_adult <- df_state[df_state$CADULT1 == 1, ]
nrow(df_adult)

# df_status <- df_adult[df_adult$POORHLTH == ]
# 查看过滤后的数据


df <- df_adult # 只查看前几行

```

```{r 筛选数据}
# 加载 dplyr 包
library(dplyr)

#统一处理NA值
df_1 <- df %>%
  #filter(
   # CADULT1 == 1, 
    #`_STATE` == 29,
    #`_EDUCAG` != 9
  #) %>%
  mutate(
    # EXEROFT1 = ifelse(EXEROFT1 %in% c(777, 999), NA, EXEROFT1),
    # EXEROFT2 = ifelse(EXEROFT2 %in% c(777, 999), NA, EXEROFT2),
    EXERHMM1 = ifelse(EXERHMM1 %in% c(777, 999), NA, EXERHMM1),
    EXERHMM2 = ifelse(EXERHMM2 %in% c(777, 999), NA, EXERHMM2),
    POORHLTH = ifelse(POORHLTH %in% c(77, 99), NA, POORHLTH),
    INCOME3 = ifelse(INCOME3 %in% c(77, 99), NA, INCOME3),
    POORHLTH = ifelse(POORHLTH == 88, 0, POORHLTH),
    CELLSEX2 = ifelse(CELLSEX2 %in% c(3, 7, 9), NA, CELLSEX2),
    `_IMPRACE` = ifelse(`_IMPRACE` == 6, NA, `_IMPRACE`),
    `_EDUCAG` = ifelse(`_EDUCAG` ==9, NA, `_EDUCAG`)
  ) %>%
  select(
    # PAFREQ1_, PAFREQ2_,
    PADUR1_, PADUR2_, POORHLTH, `_AGE_G`,
    CELLSEX2, `_IMPRACE`, INCOME3, `_EDUCAG`
    #, `_BMI5CAT`
  )

#用Multiple imputation处理MD

md.pattern(df_1, rotate.names=TRUE)
md.pairs(df_1)

df_1 <- df_1 %>%
  rename(
    AGE_G = `_AGE_G`,
    IMPRACE = `_IMPRACE`,
    EDUCAG = `_EDUCAG`,
   # BMI5CAT = `_BMI5CAT`
  )

imp <- mice(df_1, m = 10, maxit = 5, seed = 1000000)
imp

imp1 <- mice::complete(data=imp, action=1) 

imp$ID <- seq.int(nrow(imp1))
view(imp1)

summary(imp1)
```

```{r Table 1}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, readr, table1, DiagrammeR, rsvg)

names(imp2)<-c(

# 标准化频率数据

# 删去不需要的列
imp2 <- imp2 %>% select(
  # -ACT1_FREQ, -ACT2_FREQ, 
                        -ACT1_DUR, -ACT2_DUR)

# imp1$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`<-imp1$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`/7.3
view(imp2)
summary(imp2)
library(dplyr)

df_2 <- imp2 %>%
  # Recode AGE variable and create labeled factor variable
  mutate(age_f = case_when(
           AGE == 1 ~ 0,
           AGE == 2 ~ 1,
           AGE == 3 ~ 2,
           AGE == 4 ~ 3,
           AGE == 5 ~ 4,
           AGE == 6 ~ 5
         ),
         age_f = factor(age_f, labels = c("Age 18 to 24", "Age 25 to 34", "Age 35 to 44",
                                          "Age 45 to 54", "Age 55 to 64", "Age 65 or older")),
         
         # Recode SEX variable and create labeled factor variable
         sex_f = case_when(
           SEX == 1 ~ 0,
           SEX == 2 ~ 1
         ),
         sex_f = factor(sex_f, labels = c("Male", "Female")),
         
         # Recode INCOME variable and create labeled factor variable
         income_f = case_when(
           INCOME %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0,
           INCOME %in% c(3, 4) ~ 1,
           INCOME %in% c(5, 6) ~ 2,
           TRUE ~ 3
         ),
         income_f = factor(income_f, labels = c("<$15,000", "$15,000 to <$25,000",
                                                "$25,000–$50,000", ">$50,000")),
         
         # Recode RACE variable and create labeled factor variable
         race_f = case_when(
           RACE == 1 ~ 0,
           RACE == 2 ~ 1,
           RACE == 3 ~ 2,
           RACE == 4 ~ 3,
           RACE == 5 ~ 4
         ),
         race_f = factor(race_f, labels = c("White", "Black", "Asian",
                                            "American Indian/Alaskan Native", "Hispanic")),
         
         # Recode EDUCATION variable and create labeled factor variable
         education_f = case_when(
           EDUCATION == 1 ~ 0,
           EDUCATION == 2 ~ 1,
           EDUCATION == 3 ~ 2,
           EDUCATION == 4 ~ 3
         ),
         education_f = factor(education_f, labels = c("Did not graduate High School",
                                                      "Graduated High School",
                                                      "Attended College or Technical School",
                                                      "Graduated from College or Technical School")),
         
         # Recode BMI variable and create labeled factor variable
         #bmi_f = case_when(
           #BMI == 1 ~ 0,
          # BMI == 2 ~ 1,
           #BMI == 3 ~ 2,
           #BMI == 4 ~ 3
         #),
         #bmi_f = factor(bmi_f, labels = c("Underweight", "Normal Weight", "Overweight", "Obese")),

         # Recode ACT_DUR variable and create labeled factor variable for exercise intensity
         act_dur_f = case_when(
           ACT_DUR >= 0 & ACT_DUR < 150   ~ 0,
           ACT_DUR >= 150 & ACT_DUR < 300 ~ 1,
           ACT_DUR >= 300 & ACT_DUR < 600 ~ 2,
           ACT_DUR >= 600                ~ 3
         ),
         act_dur_f = factor(act_dur_f, labels = c("Low Exercise Intensity (< 150 mins/per week)", 
                                                  "Moderate Exercise Intensity (150 - 299 mins/per week)", 
                                                  "High Exercise Intensity (300 - 600 mins/per week)", 
                                                  "Extremely High Exercise Intensity (> 600 mins/per week)")),

         # Recode MENTAL HEALTH STATUS and create labeled factor variable
         `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` = case_when(
           `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` >= 0 & `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` < 10 ~ 0,
           `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` >= 10 & `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` < 20 ~ 1,
           `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` >= 20 & `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` <= 30 ~ 2
         ),
         `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` = factor(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`, labels = c("<10", "10-19", "20-30"))
  )



summary(df_2)

```

```{r Chi-test}
# 加载所需的库
library(dplyr)

# 运动强度与心理健康状况的卡方检验
chi_test_exercise_mental_health <- chisq.test(table(df_2$act_dur_f, df_2$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`))

# 打印卡方检验结果
print(chi_test_exercise_mental_health)

# 对于每个混杂因素与运动强度之间的关联进行卡方检验
chi_test_age_exercise <- chisq.test(table(df_2$age_f, df_2$act_dur_f))
chi_test_sex_exercise <- chisq.test(table(df_2$sex_f, df_2$act_dur_f))
chi_test_race_exercise <- chisq.test(table(df_2$race_f, df_2$act_dur_f))
chi_test_education_exercise <- chisq.test(table(df_2$education_f, df_2$act_dur_f))
chi_test_bmi_exercise <- chisq.test(table(df_2$bmi_f, df_2$act_dur_f))

# 打印卡方检验结果
print(chi_test_age_exercise)
print(chi_test_sex_exercise)
print(chi_test_race_exercise)
print(chi_test_education_exercise)
print(chi_test_bmi_exercise)

# 对于每个混杂因素与心理健康状况之间的关联进行卡方检验
chi_test_age_mental_health <- chisq.test(table(df_2$age_f, df_2$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`))
chi_test_sex_mental_health <- chisq.test(table(df_2$sex_f, df_2$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`))
chi_test_race_mental_health <- chisq.test(table(df_2$race_f, df_2$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`))
chi_test_education_mental_health <- chisq.test(table(df_2$education_f, df_2$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`))
chi_test_bmi_mental_health <- chisq.test(table(df_2$bmi_f, df_2$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`))

# 打印卡方检验结果
print(chi_test_age_mental_health)
print(chi_test_sex_mental_health)
print(chi_test_race_mental_health)
print(chi_test_education_mental_health)
print(chi_test_bmi_mental_health)

```


```{r MLR}
# 加载必要库
library(nnet)

# 构建多项逻辑回归模型
model <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f + age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f + income_f, data = df_2)

# 输出模型结果
summary(model)

# 转换为优势比（Odds Ratio）
exp(coef(model))

# 加入交互效应（以运动强度与种族的交互为例）
model_interaction <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f * race_f + age_f + sex_f + education_f + income_f, data = df_2)

# 输出交互模型结果
summary(model_interaction)

# 转换为优势比（Odds Ratio）
exp(coef(model_interaction))

# 比较原模型与交互模型的AIC
AIC(model)
AIC(model_interaction)

# 检查残差分布
residuals <- residuals(model, type = "pearson")
hist(residuals, main = "Residual Distribution", xlab = "Residuals")


```

```{r}
# 添加运动强度与收入水平的交互项
model_interaction <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f * income_f + age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f, data = df_2)

# 查看模型摘要
summary(model_interaction)

# 提取系数并计算优势比
exp(coef(model_interaction))


# 提取交互项系数和标准误
interaction_coeffs <- coef(summary(model_interaction))[, grep("act_dur_f.*:income_f", colnames(coef(model_interaction)))]

# 计算显著性（Z值和P值）
interaction_pvalues <- apply(interaction_coeffs, 1, function(x) {
  z_value <- x[1] / x[2]
  p_value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_value)))
  return(c(Z = z_value, P = p_value))
})

# 打印交互项显著性
interaction_pvalues


# 低收入组
low_income_data <- subset(df_2, income_f == "<$15,000")
model_low_income <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f + age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f, data = low_income_data)
summary(model_low_income)

# 中低收入组
mid_income_data <- subset(df_2, income_f == "$15,000 to <$25,000")
model_mid_income <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f + age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f, data = mid_income_data)
summary(model_mid_income)

# 中高收入组
upper_mid_income_data <- subset(df_2, income_f == "$25,000–$50,000")
model_upper_mid_income <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f + age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f, data = upper_mid_income_data)
summary(model_upper_mid_income)

# 高收入组
high_income_data <- subset(df_2, income_f == ">$50,000")
model_high_income <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f + age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f, data = high_income_data)
summary(model_high_income)




# 提取每个模型的系数和OR
low_income_or <- exp(coef(model_low_income))
mid_income_or <- exp(coef(model_mid_income))
upper_mid_income_or <- exp(coef(model_upper_mid_income))
high_income_or <- exp(coef(model_high_income))

# 汇总OR值
list(
  Low_Income_OR = low_income_or,
  Mid_Income_OR = mid_income_or,
  Upper_Mid_Income_OR = upper_mid_income_or,
  High_Income_OR = high_income_or
)


```

```{r age as modifier}
MENTAL_HEALTH_STATUS ~ act_dur_f * age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f + income_f

# 載入必要的包
library(nnet)

# 添加交互項的多項邏輯回歸模型
model_with_interaction <- multinom(
  formula = `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f * age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f + income_f,
  data = df_2
)

# 模型結果摘要
summary(model_with_interaction)

# 提取Z值和P值以檢測交互項顯著性
z_values <- summary(model_with_interaction)$coefficients / summary(model_with_interaction)$standard.errors
p_values <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_values)))

# 輸出交互項的Z值和P值
z_values
p_values




# 提取交互效應的Z值和P值
z_values <- summary(model_with_interaction)$coefficients / summary(model_with_interaction)$standard.errors
p_values <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_values)))

# 查看交互項顯著性
z_values
p_values

# 創建年齡分層數據
age_groups <- split(df_2, df_2$age_f)

# 在每個年齡層中分別建模
age_models <- lapply(age_groups, function(data) {
  multinom(
    formula = `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ act_dur_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f + income_f,
    data = data
  )
})

# 輸出每個年齡層的模型結果
lapply(age_models, summary)


# 預測心理健康狀態的機率
df_2$predicted_prob <- predict(model_with_interaction, type = "probs")[, 2]  # 假設第二列為“心理健康較差”的概率

# 繪製交互效應圖
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df_2, aes(x = act_dur_f, y = predicted_prob, color = age_f)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "交互效應：運動強度與年齡對心理健康的影響",
    x = "運動強度",
    y = "心理健康較差的概率"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# 按年齡分層的可視化檢查
library(ggplot2)
df_2$predicted_prob <- predict(model_with_interaction, type = "probs")[, 2]

ggplot(df_2, aes(x = act_dur_f, y = predicted_prob, color = age_f)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "運動強度與年齡對心理健康影響的交互效應",
    x = "運動強度",
    y = "心理健康問題的概率"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 增加非線性模型
library(splines)
model_nonlinear <- multinom(
  `MENTAL HEALTH STATUS` ~ ns(act_dur_f, df = 3) * age_f + sex_f + race_f + education_f + income_f,
  data = df_2
)
summary(model_nonlinear)


```

```{r ordinal logistic regression}
# load packages
pacman::p_load(readr, tidyverse, nnet, MASS, funModeling, brant, broom)
#bivariate analysis
table(df_2$act_dur_f, df_2$`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`)
```
```{r mlr}
model1 <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`~ act_dur_f, data=df_2)
summary(model1)
```
```{r}
# extract the coefficients from the model and exponentiate to get OR
exp(coef(model1))

# get confidence intervals for ORs
exp(confint(model1, level=0.95))

z <- summary(model1)$coefficients/summary(model1)$standard.errors

# 2-tailed Z test
p <- (1 - pnorm(abs(z), 0, 1))*2
p

# Broom

tidy(model1, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
```

```{r effect modifier}
# Model with act_dur and age
dur_mod_age <- multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`~ act_dur_f + age_f, data=df_2)
summary(dur_mod_age)

# Model with act_dur and age*act_dur
dur_mod_age_dur<-multinom(`MENTAL HEALTH STATUS`~ act_dur_f + age_f + age_f*act_dur_f, data=df_2)
summary(dur_mod_age_dur)

# Test the hypothesis with the lrtest
lrtest(dur_mod_age, dur_mod_age_dur)
```
